thread:
Aisha: FYI customer reported a regression after yesterday's rollout — tool calls are being missed or arguments are wrong. ticket# 92314. they've sent two failing requests and one that used to call get_flights but now returns plain text.
Ravi: can you paste the request/response pair and the model+rollout id?
Aisha: pasted below. customer says this used to produce a function call: get_flights({origin: \"SFO\", dest: \"JFK\", date: \"2026-04-10\"}) but now assistant replies with a sentence like \"You can search flights from SFO to JFK on April 10\" and no function_call field.
Juan: repro curl from customer (redacted api key):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "model":"rw-infer-1.2-q4",
    "messages":[
      {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant that calls tools when asked."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Find cheapest flights from SFO to JFK on 2026-04-10. Call get_flights with origin/dest/date."}
    ],
    "functions":[{"name":"get_flights","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"origin":{"type":"string"},"dest":{"type":"string"},"date":{"type":"string"}}}}],
    "function_call":"auto"
  }'
```
Aisha: customer response (trimmed):
```
HTTP 200
{
  "id":"resp_abc123",
  "model":"rw-infer-1.2-q4",
  "choices":[
    {"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"You can search flights from SFO to JFK on April 10. Do you want me to call get_flights?"}}
  ]
}
```
Aisha: no function_call key in the assistant message — previously we would see:
```
"message": {"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_flights","arguments":"{\\"origin\\":\\"SFO\\",\\"dest\\":\\"JFK\\",\\"date\\":\\"2026-04-10\\"}"}}
```
Ravi: interesting. did the customer change prompt framing at all? looks like the assistant is now asking to confirm instead of directly calling.
Tom: infra logs for request_id=resp_abc123 show successful routing. route=us-east-1, deploy=rl-42, model=rw-infer-1.2-q4, latency=210ms, no 5xx. nothing in runtime errors.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout rl-42 started 2026-03-14T07:12:03Z -> variant rw-infer-1.2-q4 (30% traffic)
Juan: customer claims regression started approx 2026-03-14 07:20 UTC which matches canary start window.
Aisha: severity is high — this breaks automation for several customers when the assistant stops invoking tools. customer is asking for rollback or a targeted route to the previous variant.
Ravi: immediate hypothesis: decoding/temperature or function_call preference changed with new model variant or decoding tweaks in runtime. we shipped a change that tweaks the tool-calling heuristic (flag: aggressive_tool_suppression=true) in the rollout — could explain asking-for-confirmation behavior.
Tom: verifying rollout manifest... yes, rl-42 included runtime flag flip for "aggressive_tool_suppression" on inference nodes. it was introduced to reduce false-positive tool calls in noisy prompts. it probably suppressed automatic calls in borderline cases.
Aisha: can we patch routing to send this customer's org to the previous stable variant (rw-infer-1.1-q8) while we investigate? they asked for immediate mitigation.
Tom: we can add a routing override for org=acme-corp that pins to rw-infer-1.1-q8. will do if product signs off.
Ravi: I'll run a quick eval: take a corpus of 250 prompt examples that previously triggered get_flights function calls and run against both variants (1.1 and 1.2) with same function definitions and function_call=auto. want to check delta in call rate and argument correctness.
Juan: trying a minimal repro: change system prompt to be explicit: "Always call get_flights when user asks for flight search." still getting text reply in 6/10 runs. reproducible locally.
Aisha: customer wants timeline and root cause. suggest we: 1) route them back to stable, 2) run the eval, 3) disable aggressive flag in rollout if confirmed, 4) notify impacted customers and offer credits.
Ravi: quick snapshot from eval harness:
- rw-infer-1.1-q8: function_call produced in 240/250 samples (96%) and args match schema in 238/250.
- rw-infer-1.2-q4 (rl-42 config): function_call produced in 167/250 samples (66.8%) and args match schema in 160/250. observed cases where assistant asks a confirmation question instead of calling.
Ravi: looks like the new heuristic lowered recall for tool calls; argument formatting is also slightly noisier in some quantized paths (q4) -> need to check tokenizer/decoder changes and kernel selection.
Tom: actioned routing override for org=acme-corp -> rw-infer-1.1-q8 and pinned until 2026-03-14T10:00Z or until we confirm fix. created internal ticket INF-5789.
Aisha: notified customer (ticket update) and offered immediate routing fix + follow-up once we have root cause. customer accepted routing and will verify.
Juan: small note — a different customer reported wrong args: instead of airport code they got full city name in argument ("San Francisco" vs "SFO"). likely prompt normalization/NER behavior changed.
Ravi: added regression test to eval: check for argument canonicalization (IATA codes) and added a failing sample. escalating to runtime team to revert the aggressive flag for next canary patch if we can't tune thresholds quickly.
deploy-bot: Canary rl-42 progress -> 30% -> paused at 2026-03-14T07:40:12Z (manual pause)
Tom: no other infra anomalies; I'll pair with Ravi to check model variant binary diff and quantization/compilation flags. Ravi, can you dump a couple of model traces for failing cases? put them in INF-5789.
Ravi: will do. plan: analyze decoder logits around function_call tokens, compare pre/post rollout, and run a targeted decode ablation with force_function_call to see if behavior is model-internal or runtime-level gating.
Aisha: thanks team. keep updates here. customer asked for ETA — tentative: 4-6 hours to confirm root cause and either roll back change or tune threshold. I'll set expectation.
Tom: noted. follow-up: if we find that q4 quantization path lost some token fidelity, we should consider reverting to q8 for function-heavy workloads until we improve arg fidelity.
Ravi: adding that to INF-5789. will report back with numbers.
Aisha: :thumbsup: closing loop for now, keeping thread pinned to ticket 92314.
